billion.en: Anyway, its initial projected cost was £18 billion, and it was expected to come online in 2025.
billion.zh: 不管怎样，其最初预计成本为180亿英镑，原计划于2025年并网发电。

billion.en: As of today, mid-2026, its projected cost is £48 billion in inflation-adjusted terms, and it's not scheduled to come online before 2030.
billion.zh: 截至今天，即2026年年中，经通胀调整后其预计成本已达480亿英镑，且预计要到2030年之后才能并网。
